subject.title: fix(agents): preserve thinking default precedence for listed agents

question: Should `resolveAgentThinkingDefaultOverride()` become a supported public plugin SDK contract for channels that must distinguish an explicit agent override from a merged default?
rationale: The Telegram plugin cannot use core internals, so this branch turns an implementation detail into a public cross-plugin API; its naming, scope, and compatibility commitment require owner intent.

options.title: Approve a narrow public helper
options.body: Keep the helper as a documented agent-runtime API, with focused contract coverage for explicit-versus-merged thinking precedence.

options.title: Avoid the new SDK contract
options.body: Choose a different supported runtime seam or redesign the caller boundary so plugins do not depend on explicit-config provenance.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow public helper
recommendation.body: Keep the helper as a documented agent-runtime API, with focused contract coverage for explicit-versus-merged thinking precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work directly established adjacent agent-thinking precedence behavior and is the strongest available routing signal.
